purpose: Controllability regression comparison; not a proprietary-engine score
conditions: Metres, seconds, radians; 120 Hz; body 0; standard Soccar; controlled identical poses/inputs. One/two-wheel cases start at 10 m/s and ground yaw 1.2 rad/s. Frozen 10.3/10.4 built HTML versus current edited source. noController is a conservative code-inferred 10.4 metric for wheel-contact samples outside stable driving, jump lock or active dodge; the repaired trace identifies the actual branch. First wheel contact denotes support-range sampling, not a force sensor. The noController metric is not scored for10.3.0, whose separate pose-recovery path was not instrumented; first-tick response and trajectory remain directly measured.
